name: Project Lyra 1
source: Hibberd, Hein & Eubanks 2020, Project Lyra: catching 1I/'Oumuamua, mission opportunities after 2024 (Acta Astronautica 170, arXiv:1902.04935), Table 2 scenario A (E-J-6SR-1I): Earth to Jupiter as a Lambert arc between JPL Horizons positions on the paper's dates; the unpowered Jupiter flyby, the fall to a 6 solar radii perihelion and the perihelion burn solved by shooting onto Horizons' 'Oumuamua position on the arrival date. The 'Oumuamua path is JPL Horizons (JPL#16).
